description: When the user is already busy, across their own Google calendars (not the details, only the times), between two days: [{ date, from, to }] as wall clock in timeZone, so a booking page can offer only free slots. Declined invitations, events marked free and holiday calendars do not count. Needs the busy-read consent: when it is missing the answer says so, and google_calendar_connect with includeBusyRead true makes the link for it.

excludeCalendarId.description: A calendar to leave out, usually the TaskLite one whose bookings the app already knows

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

timeZone.description: IANA timezone the dates and times are in, default "Asia/Jerusalem"

name: google_calendar_busy
